create.name: Il Cerchio Vuoto – Tempio Enkuji
create.bio:
Il Cerchio Vuoto is a Soto Zen association in Turin that runs the Enkuji temple. It was founded in 1996, together with the original Enku dojo, by Massimo Daido Strumia, who had trained in Japan and returned as an official Soto missionary teacher; over some forty years he led practice groups, talks and retreats across northern Italy until his death in 2010. The dojo has since become a temple, guided by his only Dharma heir, Elena Seishin Viviani, who is also vice-president of the Italian Buddhist Union and sits on Turin's interfaith committee. The association follows the teaching of Dogen and Keizan and aims to support anyone seeking freedom of spirit in their own life.

Each week the sangha meets at Enkuji for zazen, walking meditation, sutra chanting and ceremonies. A one-day sesshin is held monthly in Turin, with at least three longer retreats a year elsewhere, including a memorial sesshin for Daido Strumia, a robe-sewing sesshin and a summer ango; beginners may join after a talk with the teacher. A monthly Fukudenkai group studies traditional robe-sewing. The association also keeps a library and organises public lectures on religions and Buddhism, many of them on its YouTube channel, from the Lotus Sutra and Chan meditation to the Bhagavad Gita and Milarepa.

courses.title: Il tempio – pratica settimanale, sesshin e Fukudenkai
courses.description: Weekly zazen, walking meditation, sutras and ceremonies at the Enkuji temple in Turin; a monthly one-day sesshin, three or more longer retreats a year, and a monthly robe-sewing group. Sesshin are for members, with beginners admitted after a talk with the teacher.

flags: Channel is mostly guest lectures in the 'Voci senza tempo' series (other religions too: Qoelet, Bhagavad Gita, Sufi 'Verbo degli uccelli'); no talks by the temple's own teacher. Guests not on Spiritpedia.
One video features Rev. Annamaria Gyoetsu Epifania of Centro Zen Anshin (rank 1969).
Weekly practice times are not stated on the pages read; one undated item from the temple page.
Base: Via Carlo Ignazio Giulio 29, 10146 Turin (contact page, which also has a form).
Lead name was 'Il Cerchio Vuoto'; the temple is Enkuji. Not to be confused with Il Cerchio (Tetsugen Serra, rank 1960).
Elena Seishin Viviani is not on Spiritpedia; teachers file empty. Photo 1 is the temple's zendo; photo 2 hands in gassho.
left_out: Climate-themed 'Diritti della Natura' lectures (Luca Mercalli and others) and mountain/travel talks: not spiritual teaching.
